dedupe_keys.name: data used in assessing the use of dual drainage modeling to determine the effects of green stormwater infrastructure on roadway flooding and traffic performance

description: Data used in Assessing the Use of Dual-Drainage Modeling to Determine the Effects of Green Stormwater Infrastructure on Roadway Flooding and Traffic Performance is a data set listed in HydroShare, an online repository for hydrology data and models, published or maintained by Bhaskar, Aditi S (deposited on HydroShare). The data shared here are presented in: Knight, K.L.; Hou, G.; Bhaskar, A.S.; Chen, S. Assessing the Use of Dual-Drainage Modeling to Determine the Effects of Green Stormwater Infrastructure on Roadway Flooding and Traffic Performance. Water 2021, 13, 1563. Summary: I. Coverage: not restricted to one place in the metadata. The resource was created 2021-06-07 and last updated 2021-06-07; HydroShare lists it as a composite resource. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the HydroShare metadata only, so the files and any paper they support were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the abstract may lag the deposit. It can support infrastructure planning, operations and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hydroshare-infrastructure-resources.
